name: Immortal Fruits

features.name: xWheel Jackpots
features.description: A wheel that pays until a multiplier repeats.

review:
A 50-line fruit game on 5x4 with four-row stacked wilds on reels 2 to 4 – land all three and the middle of the grid lights up.

Three bonus symbols open the xWheel Jackpots bonus, a fortune wheel that keeps paying until the same multiplier comes up twice. There's a 50/50 gamble too. High volatility but a modest 2,787x cap, and a low 11% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
